after.label: Redesign
after.note: Guided scroll assembled from captures of the published homepage and Press page. It shows the page design and reading flow, not a recording of live hover or scroll effects.

chapters.label: Opening

chapters.caption: A clear opening and an invitation into the story.

chapters.label: Problem first

chapters.caption: Explain why botanical sourcing needs a different approach.

chapters.label: Approach
